thread:
Elaine: quick follow-up from today's all-hands about the people plan + immediate next steps. opening this thread for short Qs.
Sophie: Thanks! First Q: which teams are getting priority hiring headcount in Q3? heard various things.
Jamal: Priority: runtime (latency/cost), infra reliability/oncall automation, then platform UX (SDKs/devex). We'll allocate most of Q3 slots to runtime + infra.
Sophie: Are we hiring managers or mostly ICs?
Jamal: Mostly senior ICs. Manager hires only if we have clear ownership gaps or transitions. Hiring committee will review any manager reqs.
Praveen: If my team gets split across new pods, who handles oncall for the first 2 weeks?
Elaine: We want minimal disruption: original oncall rotations stay for 14 days while we finalize ownership. If a change is needed, managers will post a short overlap plan and shadow shifts.
Sam: Note: internal transfers are encouraged. If someone on your team wants to transfer, prioritize internal candidate for backfills where the skill match is good.
Praveen: Process for transfers?
Elaine: Start with a chat between you, your manager, and the receiving manager. If all agree, submit the internal transfer form (I'll post link). Recruiting will manage timeline; transfers get priority on relevant reqs.
Maria: Heads: please submit role briefs (max 1 page) by Fri EOD. I can open up to 8 reqs for Q3 but will triage based on priority. I'll run a 30-min sync Thu to go over briefs.
Sophie: Any changes to leveling or promo cadence because of the reorg?
Jamal: No changes to the ladder or promo cadence this quarter. We'll hold a calibration in two weeks to map levels to new squads. DM me if you see mismatches.
Sophie: Can we get a breakdown of the headcount buckets?
Elaine: Quick snapshot:
```
Bucket A: Runtime & Serving infra 30 42% of Q3 slots
Bucket B: Platform/Developer UX 30 28%
Bucket C: Customer & Solutions 30 20%
Buffer: 30 10% (float for urgent reroutes)
```
Sam: A reminder that enterprise-driven Dedicated/Private work will need a couple cross-functional hires (eng + solutions). Plan accordingly.
Praveen: Will there be any hiring freeze during the transition?
Elaine: No freeze. This is prioritized hiring; approvals will follow the buckets above.
Maria: I'll post the transfer form + checklist after Thu sync. Recruiter-bot will ping managers 48h before the submit deadline.
Recruiter-bot: Reminder set: submit role briefs by Fri EOD -> #all-hands
Sophie: When is the org map coming?
Elaine: Draft map Wed, feedback window Thu-Fri, final publish next Mon. It will include reporting lines and suggested overlap owners for transitions.
Praveen: Last Q: will comp bands be adjusted?
Sam: Comp bands remain on the annual review cycle. Any exceptions handled case-by-case by People Ops.
Sophie: Thanks, that helps. I'll hand off some internal candidates to Maria after Thu sync.
Elaine: Appreciate it. Closing thread for now; will reopen if extra follow-ups pop up. :pray:
